definition: to take something by force from its owner
description: A flat cartoon in stick-figure style. Behind a service counter a plain white figure stands with a clipboard in front of him. Through the window behind him a black masked figure smashes the glass, and shards fall on the floor. The masked figure climbs in, points a revolver over the counter and shouts at the clerk, who stares back without moving. After the clerk answers him, the masked figure lowers the gun, turns away and walks back out through the broken window, past the parked cars in the street, leaving the shattered glass and the untouched counter behind.
transcript: Nobody move! Give me all your money! Where's the vault? We don't have one. Then what do you keep here? Samples. Sorry. Wrong bank.
